body:
ashley: Heads up — we're seeing a p99 latency spike on shared-gpu-pool-6 starting at 11:12:29 UTC. p50 went 40ms -> 120ms, p99 ~ 2.4s. Topline looks correlated with a burst from tenant echo-ai. infra alert: https://grafana.example.com/d/pool-6

mike: grabbing flamegraphs now. do we have a kernel-autoswitch event at that time?

ashley: yes, kernel-autoswitch toggled from 'int8-opt' -> 'fp16-kernel-v2' at 11:12:28 per logs. perf profile attached:

```
2026-03-17T11:12:28Z kernel_switch: pool=6 from int8-opt -> fp16-kernel-v2 reason=latency_estimate
kv_cache_miss_rate=0.27 batch_size_hist=[1:0.62,4:0.18,16:0.10,64:0.10]
```

priya: that batch_size_hist looks odd — lot of small batches plus a tail. switching to fp16 might've increased compute per-token for those small batches, hurting p50. also kv miss up to 27% -> more recompute.

sebastian: I see KV slot churn in the same window. few tenants (echo-ai + fast-chat) evicting each other's prefixes. attachment: kv_eviction.log

infra-bot: alert: pool-6 latency-surge (p99>1.5s). Autoscaler unchanged. implicated-tenants=[echo-ai, fast-chat, internal-smoketests]

mike: can someone replay a representative request and run profiler? if autoswitch is heuristics-driven we may need to adjust threshold.

ashley: replayed small seq workload -> cold KV -> kernel flip often triggers because sequence-length estimator mis-predicts. repro script:

```
# repro: simulate many short requests
for i in $(seq 1 500); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.local/v1/generate -d '{"input":"hi"}' &
done
```

nora: temporary mitigation: apply per-tenant concurrency cap 20 on echo-ai and fast-chat in pool-6 to reduce KV churn. want me to push? :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: please push cap, also pin pool-6 to int8-opt for 30m as rollback. rolling now.

deploy-bot: action: set-concurrency-cap tenant=echo-ai pool=6 cap=20 by=nora

deploy-bot: action: set-pool-kernel pool=6 kernel=int8-opt duration=30m by=sre-oncall

priya: after caps + pin, p50 back to ~45ms, p99 ~300ms. still higher than baseline but acceptable. we'll follow-up with kernel-selection tuning.

mike: next steps: 1) add KV-awareness to kernel-autoswitch heuristic (do not flip if kv_miss_rate > 0.15). 2) adjust sequence-length estimator to use short-request bias. 3) add per-tenant eviction-score to favor hot prefixes.

ashley: filing a short postmortem and a perf test to ensure autotuner doesn't flip under high-kv-miss small-batch workloads. I'll create a PR for the heuristic change.

sebastian: logging: add metric kernel_switch_count and kv_miss_rate per-tenant in pool metrics so we can alert earlier.

ashley: thanks all. copying notes into #incidents and will link the postmortem when done. :rocket:
